title: P1-W1: Tenant domain lib (entity, members, roles, feature flags, API keys)
description: Create libs/domains/tenants/ with TenantEntity, TenantMemberEntity, TenantRoleEntity, TenantFeatureFlagEntity, TenantApiKeyEntity, TenantInvoiceEntity, TenantSubscriptionEntity. TenantContext (request-scoped) + TenantResolverMiddleware (JWT claim or X-SwiftShip-Api-Key header). TenantGuard GraphQL guard. TenantFeatureFlagService with flag(tenantId, key, default) API. Files: libs/domains/tenants/src/lib/{tenant.entity,tenant-member.entity,tenant-role.entity,tenant-feature-flag.entity,tenant-api-key.entity,tenant-invoice.entity,tenant-subscription.entity,tenant.model,tenant.input,tenant.service,tenant.resolver,tenant.module,tenant.guard,tenant.middleware,tenant-feature-flag.service}.ts; index.ts barrel; project.json; tsconfig*.json; package.json.

title: P1-W1: TypeORM migration to add tenantId on every domain entity
description: Single TypeORM migration that adds tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL column + index to every domain entity (orders, shipments, billing, warehouses, notifications, serviceability, rate-shop, ecommerce-integrations, carriers, cod, ndr, manifests, pickups, returns, shipping-rates, users, webhooks, plugins, surcharges, dashboard, storage, metrics, onboarding, payments, bulk-operations). Backfill existing rows with tenant_id=1 ('system tenant'). Add a ForeignKey to tenants(id). Constraint is NOT VALID initially, then VALIDATE in a follow-up to keep the migration fast. Files: libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/migrations/1718160000000-AddTenantId.ts. Then update each entity file to declare the column. Then update every existing repository injection to filter by tenantId.

title: P1-W2: Per-tenant rate limits via Postgres-backed throttler
description: Extend @nestjs/throttler storage to Postgres (replace in-memory) so limits hold across API instances. TenantThrottlerGuard looks up tenantId from TenantContext, reads tenantTier, picks bucket size: Starter 60/min, Growth 300/min, Pro 1000/min, Enterprise 10000/min. Response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset. Files: libs/platform/throttler/{throttler.module,throttler.service,postgres-storage.service,tenant-throttler.guard}.ts; lib barrel; project.json. Wire into apps/api/src/app.module.ts replacing the global ThrottlerGuard with TenantThrottlerGuard.

title: P1-W3: Tenant wallet + idempotency-keyed double-entry ledger
description: WalletEntity (one per tenant): availableBalance, reservedBalance, lifetimeRecharged. WalletLedgerEntity: every credit/debit row, idempotency-keyed, double-entry. Mutations: topUpWallet(input), transferBetweenWallets, lockFunds(input), releaseFunds, walletStatement(filter). Auto-deduct on: courier label generation, NDR-reattempt call, branded-tracking-page custom domain, WhatsApp message. Extend existing BillingService to invoice wallet top-ups with GST split. Files: libs/domains/tenants/src/lib/{wallet.entity,wallet-ledger.entity,wallet.model,wallet.input,wallet.service,wallet.resolver}.ts; libs/domains/billing/src/lib/wallet-invoice.service.ts. Add a unit-test fixture that exercises top-up → lock → debit → ledger balance assertion.

title: P1-W4: Tenant onboarding + sub-accounts + API key rotation
description: onboardTenant(input) mutation: creates tenant + first user + wallet with free credit + default API key. inviteTeamMember(email, role) + acceptInvite(token). rotateApiKey(oldKeyId). Sub-account model: tenant can have child tenants (agencies managing multiple D2C brands), each with its own wallet + API keys + feature flags. Files: libs/domains/tenants/src/lib/{onboarding.service,invite.model,invite.entity,api-key.service}.ts; tenant.resolver additions. Acceptance: a second tenant signs up via GraphQL, gets its own JWT, hits /graphql, sees only its own orders/shipments, gets a different rate-limit bucket, receives a wallet top-up invoice.

title: P2-W5: Expand carrier adapter interface (getRates, getServiceability, schedulePickup, markCodCollected, getNdrActions)
description: Add 5 new methods to libs/platform/carriers/src/lib/adapter.interface.ts: getRates(req), getServiceability(pincode, paymentMethod, weight), schedulePickup(...), cancelPickup(...), markCodCollected(...), getNdrActions(shipmentId). Also add a manifestUpload(...) optional method. Each method's return type goes in libs/platform/carriers/src/lib/types.ts. Update the CarrierAdapter base abstract class to throw NotImplementedError for each new method so adapters that don't implement them fail loud.

title: P2-W5: Implement getRates/getServiceability across existing 8 carriers
description: Per-adapter implementation of getRates and getServiceability for: Delhivery, BlueDart, Xpressbees, DTDC, Ecom Express, Shadowfax, FedEx India, Gati. Fallback to the static rate card (libs/domains/shipping-rates/) when the live call fails. Each adapter is a parallelizable sub-task. Files: libs/platform/carriers/src/lib/adapters/<name>.adapter.ts updates + a small per-carrier live rate test that mocks the carrier HTTP API. Acceptance: a single call to rateShop(request) returns ≥1 RateQuote from each of the 8 carriers.

title: P2-W5: Add DHL, Aramex, India Post, Professional Couriers adapters
description: Four new carrier adapters. DhlAdapter: DHL Express India API, OAuth2 client_credentials. AramexAdapter: Aramex rate calculator. IndiaPostAdapter: India Post Business API (Speed Post, Business Parcel). ProfessionalCouriersAdapter: PCA. Each adapter implements the full interface. Files: libs/platform/carriers/src/lib/adapters/{dhl,aramex,india-post,professional-couriers}.adapter.ts + per-adapter test mocks. Register each in carrier-adapter.service.ts guarded by env credentials.

title: P2-W7: Rate cache (Redis, 10-min TTL) + per-carrier circuit breaker
description: RateCacheService: Redis-backed, 10-min TTL, keyed by (originPincode, destPincode, weight, paymentMethod, carrier). CarrierCircuitBreaker per carrier using opossum: opens after 3/10 failures, half-open after 60s, exponentially increasing reset. Background rate-prewarm worker: for the top 100 origin×destination pairs per tenant, re-fetch every 30 min so live pricing is always warm. Files: libs/domains/rate-engine/src/lib/{rate-cache.service,carrier-circuit-breaker,rate-prewarm.worker}.ts; rate-engine module.

title: P2-W8: RateRankingService (cost + SLA + courier-score + RTO-penalty)
description: New libs/domains/rate-engine/ with RateRankingService. Inputs: RateQuote[] from multiple carriers + tenant preferences (cheapest/fastest/sla-bound/courier-score/lowest-rto-rate). Score = α·normalizedCost + β·slaScore + γ·courierScore + δ·rtoRatePenalty. Weights per tenant stored in TenantPreferenceEntity. Courier score = 30-day rolling (delivery rate × on-time rate × NDR resolution rate). pickForOrder(orderId, mode) returns top-1 (or top-N). Persist every decision to RateDecisionEntity for audit. Files: libs/domains/rate-engine/src/lib/{rate-engine.module,rate-ranking.service,rate-decision.entity,tenant-preference.entity,rate-engine.model,rate-engine.resolver}.ts. Latency target: sub-100ms p95 for top-1 decision.

title: P2-W9: Weight-break + zone + surcharge math (live fuel surcharge from MyPetrolPrice RSS)
description: WeightBreakCalculator: given weight, find right slab (250g/500g/1kg/2kg/5kg/10kg) and per-kg rate. ZoneCalculator: origin state + dest state → zone (A/B/C/D/E/North-East/J&K). SurchargeApplier: COD surcharge, fuel surcharge (% from monthly diesel index), remote-area surcharge, insurance, handling fee. Extend SurchargeEntity with a kind enum (WEIGHT_BREAK|ZONE|COD|FUEL|REMOTE|INSURANCE|HANDLING). Daily cron fuel-surcharge-pull worker pulls MyPetrolPrice RSS for diesel in metros, applies deterministic formula. Files: libs/domains/rate-engine/src/lib/{weight-break.calculator,zone.calculator,surcharge.entity,surcharge.service,fuel-surcharge.worker}.ts.

title: P2-W10: SLA + courier scorecard (30/60/90-day metrics)
description: SlaMetricsService: per-carrier per-zone: average TAT, on-time delivery rate, NDR rate, RTO rate, damage rate, delivered-to-attempted ratio. CourierScorecard: composite score used by ranking engine. Backfill job runs over last 90 days of ShipmentEntity rows on first deploy. Files: libs/domains/dashboard/src/lib/{sla-metrics.service,courier-scorecard.service,sla-backfill.worker}.ts.

title: P2-W11: Rate simulator ('what if') — Shiprocket-killer feature
description: simulateRates(orders, courierOptions): given a batch of historical orders, returns the cost/SLA outcome for each courier choice + the optimal split. Surface in admin portal as 'What if you'd used Xpressbees for North-East shipments? You'd save ₹X / lose Y days on average.' Files: libs/domains/rate-engine/src/lib/{simulator.service,simulator.model,simulator.resolver}.ts + admin-portal page at apps/admin-portal/app/rate-simulator/page.tsx. Don't ship to prod; surface behind a feature flag.

title: P2-W12: Public rate-shop endpoint + embeddable rate-shop.js widget + rate-card publish page
description: Unauthenticated publicRateShop(input) mutation: for merchant's checkout widget, returns stripped RateQuote (no internal scores, just price + ETA + branded courier name). Embeddable JS widget <script src=https://cdn.swiftship.ai/rate-shop.js data-tenant=acme>: drops courier selector into any checkout. Rate-card publish: every tenant can publish a public rate-card page (/r/<tenant-slug>) for their resellers to see negotiated rates. Files: libs/domains/rate-engine/src/lib/{public-rate-shop.resolver,public-rate-shop.service}.ts; apps/web/app/r/[slug]/page.tsx; apps/web/public/widget/rate-shop.js. Target: <30KB gzipped, no framework, CSP-friendly.

title: P2-W12: Hook rate-engine into order creation (auto-pick a carrier)
description: Wire RateRankingService into OrdersService.createOrder. When a new order is created without an explicit courier, call rateRanking.pickForOrder(orderId, mode) to pick one and pre-assign it to the resulting shipment. Persist the RateDecisionEntity for the audit trail. Files: libs/domains/orders/src/lib/orders.service.ts (modify createOrder); libs/domains/orders/src/lib/orders.module.ts (import RateRankingService). Acceptance: a new order through the GraphQL createOrder mutation has a non-null shipment.carrierId.

title: P2-W10: Courier score entity + ingestion worker (per-carrier on-time / NDR / RTO feeds)
description: CourierScoreDailyEntity: (carrierId, zone, day, delivered, onTime, ndr, rto, damaged). Ingestion worker pulls from carrier performance feeds (Delhivery, BlueDart, etc.) daily and writes to the table. Index on (carrierId, day) for fast lookups. Feeds SS-012's CourierScorecard. Files: libs/domains/dashboard/src/lib/{courier-score.entity,courier-score.worker,courier-score.service}.ts.

title: P3-W13: NDR state machine + ingestion worker (all 8 carriers)
description: NdrStatus enum: RAISED → ACTION_REQUESTED → CUSTOMER_RESPONDED → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → RESOLVED | RTO_INITIATED. NdrIngestWorker pulls NDR feeds from every carrier every 15 min (Delhivery webhook, others polling). NdrActionService generates the recommended action per NDR: REATTEMPT | CHANGE_ADDRESS | CANCEL | OPEN_DISPUTE. Based on past NDR resolutions from the same customer. Files: libs/domains/ndr/src/lib/{ndr-state-machine,ndr-ingest.worker,ndr-action.service,ndr-status.enum}.ts; add the new statuses to NdrStatus enum.

title: P3-W14: WhatsApp (WATI) + Calling (Exotel) automation for NDR
description: WhatsappProvider: WATI primary, Gupshup backup. Sends interactive messages on NDR: 'Your order is at the wrong address. Confirm the new address or reschedule delivery?' CallingProvider: Exotel primary, Ozonetel backup. Voice call fallback when WhatsApp doesn't get a reply in 2 hours. NdrBot orchestrates channel choice, retry policy, quiet hours. Per-tenant enable/disable + per-tenant template approval flow. Files: libs/domains/ndr/src/lib/{whatsapp.provider,calling.provider,ndr-bot.service,channel-approval.service,ndr-template.entity}.ts; libs/platform/comm-channels/ (new lib).

title: P3-W15: RTO state machine + auto wallet credit + dispute queue
description: RtoStatus enum: INITIATED → PICKED_UP → IN_TRANSIT → DELIVERED → INSPECTED → RESTOCKED | DAMAGED. RtoReconcileWorker pulls RTO events from carriers, auto-credits the wallet for the COD amount minus the RTO charge (per-carrier RTO fee schedule). DisputeQueue for RTOs the merchant disputes ('I never got the return back'). Files: libs/domains/ndr/src/lib/{rto-state-machine,rto-reconcile.worker,rto-fee.service,dispute.service,dispute.entity}.ts; libs/domains/tenants/src/lib/wallet.service.ts extension to handle the credit-on-RTO event.

title: P4-W16: Branded customer tracking page (Next.js SSR)
description: Public route at swiftship.ai/track/<tenant-slug>?awb=... (Next.js SSR in apps/web). Per-tenant branding: logo, color, support phone, support WhatsApp link, FAQ. Live tracking via Socket.IO (trackingUpdates subscription, already exists). 'Request reattempt' button → fires an NDR action. 'Request return' button → starts the return flow. SEO: static HTML, no client JS for the basic lookup, Open Graph tags for shareability. Files: apps/web/app/track/[slug]/page.tsx; libs/domains/shipments/src/lib/tenant-branding.service.ts; apps/web/lib/apollo-tracking.ts (Socket.IO client).

title: P4-W17: End-customer return portal (photo upload, refund-method picker)
description: Public route at swiftship.ai/return/<token> (token generated when merchant issues a return). Customer picks return reason (sized-too-small / damaged / wrong-item / not-as-described / other). Customer uploads 1-3 photos (S3 multipart). Customer picks refund method (original / wallet credit / exchange). Backend creates the RTO shipment and schedules a reverse pickup. Per-tenant branded, embeddable as a widget. Files: apps/web/app/return/[token]/page.tsx; libs/domains/returns/src/lib/{return-token.service,return-photo.service,rto-scheduler}.ts; libs/platform/storage/ for the photo upload.

title: P4-W18: Embeddable JS widgets (rate-shop.js, tracking.js, return.js)
description: Three embeddable widgets: rate-shop.js (built in W12), tracking.js (drops a tracking widget into the merchant's order-confirmation page), return.js (drops a 'request return' button). All <30KB gzipped, no framework, CSP-friendly, served from a CDN. Each widget auto-resolves the tenant from a data-tenant attribute, talks to the GraphQL endpoint, and renders itself into a single div target. Files: apps/web/public/widget/{rate-shop,tracking,return}.js; libs/domains/widgets/ if a backend support lib is needed; docs/widgets.md.

title: P5-W19: Amazon IN adapter (SP-API: orders, inventory, tracking push)
description: AmazonAdapter: SP-API (Selling Partner API) for orders, inventory, tracking push. OAuth install flow (LWA — Login with Amazon). Order pull every 5 min via the Orders SP-API endpoint. Tracking push via the fulfillment feed. Inventory sync via the inventory feed. Files: libs/domains/channels/src/lib/adapters/amazon.adapter.ts; libs/domains/channels/src/lib/{lwa-auth.service,amazon-fulfillment-feed.service,amazon-inventory-feed.service}.ts; libs/domains/channels/src/lib/adapters/amazon.test.ts (sandbox account).

title: P5-W20: Flipkart adapter (Seller API: orders, shipping, returns)
description: FlipkartAdapter: Flipkart Seller API for orders, shipping, returns. Order pull + tracking push. Returns reconciliation. Files: libs/domains/channels/src/lib/adapters/flipkart.adapter.ts; libs/domains/channels/src/lib/{flipkart-auth.service,flipkart-shipping.service}.ts.

title: P5-W21: Meesho + Myntra adapters (parallel)
description: MeeshoAdapter: Meesho Supplier Panel API. Bulk order pulls, single SKU catalog. MyntraAdapter: Myntra Partner API. Smaller volume but high-AOV. Files: libs/domains/channels/src/lib/adapters/{meesho,myntra}.adapter.ts + auth services + sandbox tests. PREVIOUSLY re-ran without prerequisite — Amazon adapter (SS-023) has now committed the canonical channel-adapter.interface.ts, channel.types.ts, channels.module.ts, amazon.adapter.ts, flipkart.adapter.ts + flipkart-auth.service.ts + lwa-auth.service.ts. Use those as the reference patterns. Match the spec interface signatures (PullOrdersRequest, PushTrackingRequest, SyncInventoryRequest, PullReturnsRequest — NOT the older fromDate/toDate shape).

title: P5-W22: ChannelSyncService (channel-agnostic) + per-channel UI
description: ChannelSyncService: every adapter conforms to pullOrders, pushTracking, syncInventory, pullReturns. Channel-specific settings UI in admin portal. Per-channel courier assignment (use the channel's delivery, not your own). Channel billing reconciliation: how much did Amazon deduct for shipping, how much did you charge the seller? Files: libs/domains/channels/src/lib/{channel-sync.service,channel-adapter.interface,channel.model,channel.resolver,billing-recon.service}.ts; apps/admin-portal/app/channels/page.tsx.

title: P6-W23: Public REST API (tsoa) + 3 official SDKs (Node, Python, PHP)
description: apps/api-public/: thin REST API (Express + tsoa) mirroring the GraphQL surface. Webhook receivers + external integrators prefer REST. @swiftship/node SDK (published to npm), @swiftship/python SDK (PyPI), @swiftship/php SDK (Packagist). Postman collection auto-generated from the GraphQL SDL. OpenAPI spec generated from the REST API. AsyncAPI spec from the GraphQL subscriptions. Files: apps/api-public/{src,package.json,project.json,tsconfig.json,openapi.json}; packages/node/, packages/python/, packages/php/ for the SDKs; postman/swiftship.postman_collection.json; openapi/swiftship.openapi.json; asyncapi/swiftship.asyncapi.json.

title: P6-W24: OpenTelemetry + Sentry + audit log + correlation IDs + status page
description: OpenTelemetry SDK with traces, metrics, logs. Sentry integration (server + browser). AuditLog entity: every admin action (refund, void invoice, role change, key rotation) with actorId, tenantId, action, payload, ip, userAgent, correlationId. RequestIdMiddleware: every request gets a X-Request-Id header, threaded through logs. Per-tenant health checks at /health/<tenant-slug>. Status page (use Statuspage or self-host with upptime). Incident playbook runbook in RUNBOOK.md. Files: libs/observability/src/lib/{otel.module,sentry.module,audit-log.entity,audit-log.service,request-id.middleware,tenant-health.controller}.ts; RUNBOOK.md; deploy/status-page/ upptime config.

title: Cross-cutting: Weekly Prisma → TypeORM compat shim removal (1 lib/week)
description: Each week, pick one lib from MIGRATION.md §4b ('Still on PrismaCompat') and migrate it to a real TypeORM repository using the runbook in §7. Update MIGRATION.md §4a/b. By W12, only ~5 libs should remain on the shim; by W24, the shim is gone. The compat shim is the only blocker for Plan 5. Track progress in MIGRATION.md weekly.

title: Cross-cutting: Nx project-graph health check (no cycles, lib layers)
description: Add a CI step that runs `npx nx graph --file=graph.json` and a small Node script that asserts: (1) no cycles, (2) every domain lib depends only on platform/shared/observability, (3) no platform lib depends on a domain lib, (4) every lib has a project.json + tsconfig.json + tsconfig.lib.json + index.ts. Fails the CI if any rule is violated. Files: scripts/check-nx-graph.mjs; .github/workflows/ci.yml modification to add a 'graph' job.
